meta.noise: NoiseModel.from_backend(gate errors + thermal relaxation, no idle noise) + calibrated readout applied to the exact density-matrix distribution; multinomial shot noise

exceedance/direct.note: amplitude encoding of sqrt(p) on 100 states, a = mu

exceedance/tilt.note: tilted law + bounded weight on objective qubit, a = mu e^{eta Lmin - Lambda}

joint_exhaustion/direct.note: amplitude encoding of sqrt(p) on 100 states, a = mu

joint_exhaustion/tilt.note: tilted law, good state = unique maximum of L (weight 1, no objective qubit)

assumptions.basis: Heron-class: ~250 us default rep delay + ~2 us circuit+readout (k<=1) => ~3.9 kHz upper bound; 1 kHz allows for dynamical decoupling, twirling and job overhead
assumptions.open_plan_note: verify the current plan terms on the IBM Quantum Platform before booking; terms change

coarse_encoding.verdict: circular: the loaded amplitude is the answer; a hardware run would test nothing about the model

emulator_fallback.note: all numbers here come from a CPU-only emulator (Aer density matrix on a 10-qubit patch, ~minutes); the fallback for the milestone is this same pipeline, with the hardware run replaced by sampling from the noisy emulator
